why_not_one_block_off: No shared corridor exists. Sheet 45 draws Avenues L, M, M-1/2 and N, and its east margin plate reference reads 46; sheet 47 draws Avenues O-1/2, P, P-1/2 and Q, and its west margin plate reference reads 46. Sheet 46 lies between them, carrying Avenue O and the remainder of N, so 45 and 47 have no corridor in common. Sheet 45's easternmost labelled corridor is 'AVENUE N' (label at native x ~3145, sheet ends at 3327); sheet 47's westernmost is 'AVENUE O-1/2' (label at native x ~136). The detection candidates (45 x=2759, 47 x=574) are Avenue M-1/2 and Avenue P respectively - two different streets - so no honest identification can be made and none is recorded.
